column2: Guard true iff the broadcast record's stored frequency is exactly 666.00 kHz; unpack zeroes the low byte below 1.8 MHz
column6: not required to be the active record

column2: No abs16/abs32 writer of FF910A-FF910D; writers are unpack, default builder, EEPROM 0x980 restore, and record-relative tuning stores
column3: Confirmed (Not found abs, scope MAIN 0..0x80000 raw + IDA heads)

column2: Factory defaults for FF90F0: band 0 = 540.00 kHz, band 4 = 95.75 MHz, band 3 = 76 or 88 MHz by market; none equals 666 kHz

column2: Raw 0x16 is built only at 0x00FBC6 from encoder latches FF8171 (IRQ7) or FFBBE3 (IRQ10), chosen by FF89B5; event = raw-9 = 13
IRQ7 (vector 71, 0x29CA) and IRQ10 (vector 74, 0x2A60) are quadrature-encoder ISRs: they flip the IRQ edge select each time and compare port 0xFFFF4E b3 / b1 with the edge state
Event 13 = DIAL knob step: slot 13 is the tuning handler on home tables and the value stepper on setting screens; the stepper reads A9EE.b0 as up/down
column6: the other encoder sets AA38.b6 (sub_FC56) = second knob

column2: FF89B5 (R1 0x95, EEPROM 0x615, default 1) is setup item F396 "DIAL KNOB CHANGE"; it swaps which encoder is the DIAL
Node command 'A' (slot 0x11, sub_73EB4) injects keys: arg <0x0A digit, 0x0A-0x16 -> event 1-13; arg 0x16 = remote DIAL step
Not found: raw 0x16 from the key matrix (codes 0x0A-0x12 only) or from touch (L6 zones: A9ED in {0,1,2,4,7,9,0x0A})
FF8920.b7 = "Bluetooth Save" (F3D4, screen 0x1F, group 11 item 3)

BB8F.b7 = Bluetooth power-save engaged: set by sub_73412 after FF95A1 (100 ms tier) expires with BT on, VOX off, BT Save on, no TX/activity; cleared on activity, on BT Save toggle (FF95A1=200) or when gates drop
